messages.text: I won’t post publicly because I completely support what you do, but I have to tell you I purchased the insoles and they did nothing. Absolutely no difference in warmth from just wearing wool socks. I don’t want a refund, just want you to know this product does not work as you claim.

Hello Nancy'

I owe you a real apology for how long this sat unanswered. We had a rough stretch with staffing and some messages simply didn't get the attention they deserved. That's on us and I'm sorry.

We are extremely sorry about the situation. This level of wear is completely abnormal and not representative of the results obtained during our research and development work.

In this situation, we would include you in our Research and Development program. In short, being included in our R&D program means that we would have you take part in improving the product for our next model, which you would receive free of charge in one or more units (prototypes and/or the final version for the following winter).

We look forward to hearing from you to see if this plan works for you.
Given the cost of mailing to the U.S. these days, I hate for you to spend the $$ on that, but I appreciate the offer. I do wish you success.
